options.name: adv_dhcp_config_advanced
options.description: Enables or disables the advanced DHCP settings on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_config_file_override
options.description: Enables or disables overriding the entire DHCP configuration file for this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_config_file_override_path
options.displayName: Adv Dhcp Config File Override Path
options.description: Sets the local file path of the custom DHCP configuration file.

options.name: adv_dhcp_option_modifiers
options.description: Sets DHCP option modifiers applied to the obtained DHCP lease.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_backoff_cutoff
options.description: Manually sets the backoff cutoff timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_initial_interval
options.description: Manually sets the initial interval timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_reboot
options.description: Manually sets the reboot timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_retry
options.description: Manually sets the retry timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_select_timeout
options.description: Manually sets the select timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_timeout
options.description: Manually sets the timeout timing value used when requested DHCP leases on this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_pt_values
options.description: Selects the advanced DHCP timing preset.

options.name: adv_dhcp_request_options
options.description: Sets DHCP option 55 values to be sent when requesting a DHCP lease for this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_required_options
options.description: Sets DHCP options required by the client when requesting a DHCP lease for this interface.

options.name: adv_dhcp_send_options
options.description: Sets DHCP options to be sent when requesting a DHCP lease for this interface.

options.name: alias_address
options.description: Sets the value used as a fixed alias IPv4 address by the DHCP client.

options.name: alias_subnet
options.description: Sets the value used as the fixed alias IPv4 address's subnet bit count by the DHCP client.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: blockbogons
options.description: Enable or disable automatically blocking bogon networks on this interface.

options.name: blockpriv
options.description: Enable or disable automatically blocking RFC 1918 private networks on this interface.

options.name: descr
options.description: The descriptive name for this interface.

options.name: dhcphostname
options.description: Sets the DHCP hostname this interface will advertise via DHCP.

options.name: dhcprejectfrom
options.description: Sets a list of IPv4 DHCP server addresses to reject DHCP offers for on this interface.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enable or disable this interface.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Sets the upstream gateway this interface will use. This is only applicable for WAN-type interfaces.

options.name: gateway_6rd
options.description: Sets the 6RD IPv4 gateway address assigned by the ISP for this interface.

options.name: gatewayv6
options.description: Sets the upstream IPv6 gateway this interface will use. This is only applicable for WAN-type interfaces.

options.name: if
options.description: The real interface this configuration will be applied to.

options.name: ipaddr
options.description: Sets the IPv4 address to assign to this interface.

options.name: ipaddrv6
options.description: Sets the IPv6 address to assign to this interface.

options.name: ipv6usev4iface
options.description: Enable or disable IPv6 using the IPv4 connectivity link (PPPoE).

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: media
options.description: Sets the link speed for this interface. In most situations this can be left as the default.

options.name: mediaopt
options.description: Sets the link duplex for this interface. In most situations this can be left as the default.

options.name: mss
options.description: Sets the MSS for this interface. Assumes default MSS if value is `null`.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Sets the MTU for this interface. Assumes default MTU if value is `null`.

options.name: prefix_6rd
options.description: Sets the 6RD IPv6 prefix assigned by the ISP for this interface.

options.name: prefix_6rd_v4plen
options.description: Sets the 6RD IPv4 prefix length. Normally specified by the ISP. A value of 0 means embed theentire IPv4 address in the 6RD prefix.

options.name: slaacusev4iface
options.description: Enable or disable IPv6 using the IPv4 connectivity link (PPPoE).

options.name: spoofmac
options.description: Assigns (spoofs) the MAC address for this interface instead of using the interface's real MAC.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: subnet
options.description: Sets the subnet bit count to assign this interface.

options.name: subnetv6
options.description: Sets the subnet bit count to assign this interface.

options.name: track6_interface
options.description: Sets the dynamic IPv6 WAN interface to track for configuration.

options.name: track6_prefix_id_hex
options.description: Sets the hexadecimal IPv6 prefix ID. This determines the configurable network ID based on the dynamic IPv6 connection.

options.name: typev4
options.description: Selects the IPv4 address type to assign this interface.

options.name: typev6
options.description: Selects the IPv6 address type to assign this interface.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
